reason: The displayed power-set inference has a concrete type error for the geometric simplicial complex K used by the Munkres triangulation route: a simplex sigma is its convex hull (a set of points), not literally a nonempty finite subset of the global vertex set V. For example, the geometric 1-simplex [0,1] contains interior points and is not a subset of V={0,1}; hence K is not a subcollection of P(V), so the stated justification is false. The desired conclusion is repairable, but requires the different argument that sigma maps injectively to its finite vertex set Vert(sigma) subseteq V (with uniqueness of a simplex from its vertices); that fact is neither stated nor established here.
